$comment: Cross-asset instrument catalogue. `key` is an archive asset field, or a derived id with `expr` (spread: (a−b)×scale · fly: (2×body−w1−w2)×scale · pctvs: (a/b−1)×100 · rel: a/b rebased to 100). `fmt`: yield | prob | bp | index | fx | level | pctlvl. `sub` groups rows inside a tab. `freq`: monthly (prints) or policy (decided rates), drawn as steps without per-session statistics. `note` explains a derived series in the drill-down. `label` may use {asof:<field>}. `dimensionLinks` maps each regime dimension to the instrument it reads, for navigation. Ops without carry-forward (gaps stay empty): coalesce (first present of `keys`), breadth (S&P 500 member counts: pct = adv/(adv+dec), ratio = adv/dec), relret (compound daily % of `a` against the archive series `b`, 100 at the close before the first observation). `freq: flow` marks a daily return or spread: drawn as bars with sum / mean / hit-rate statistics instead of level changes. ratio: a / b (unscaled). geo: geo_state[j][f] minus the archive series `minus`, × scale (G10 layer; no carry-forward).

rows.label: 2s10s
rows.note: US 10Y minus US 2Y.

rows.label: 10s30s
rows.note: US 30Y minus US 10Y.

rows.label: 2s10s30s fly
rows.note: 2 × 10Y − 2Y − 30Y. Positive = belly cheap to the wings.

rows.label: 3M–10Y
rows.note: US 10Y minus the 3-month bill: the classic recession-watch curve. Negative = inverted.

rows.label: 5s30s
rows.note: US 30Y minus US 5Y: the long end against the belly.

rows.label: 2Y − Fed funds
rows.note: Front end over the policy rate: roughly what the market prices beyond the current setting.

rows.label: Real policy rate
rows.note: Fed funds minus core PCE inflation (YoY). Positive = policy is restrictive in real terms. Moves only when the policy rate or the monthly core PCE print changes.

rows.label: Real 10Y proxy

rows.label: HY − IG
rows.note: High-yield over investment-grade option-adjusted spread.
